# Agent-bound tokens + mTLS

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P2 · Proven identity](../README.md#phase-2--proven-identity) · **Lane:** Worker · **Label:** `feature:identity-enforcement` · **Epic:** [#110](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/110) · **Tickets:** 5 (1S 4M)

Workers verify CP-issued Warden tokens instead of raw Dex tokens, check the token is bound to the agent presenting it, and can enforce `require` mode where unauthenticated traffic is refused. Workers also talk to the CP over mTLS and expose identity failure metrics.

## How we build it

- Verification in a new `internal/identity` token verifier path (extending the P1 verifier): JWKS comes from the signed bundle (no runtime fetch to the CP), alg allowlist EdDSA/ES256, iss=configured CP issuer, aud=warden-worker, exp/nbf with 30s leeway, kid must be in bundle JWKS.
- cnf binding: worker maps listener port -> agent id (agentid.PortBindingIdentifier) and requires `act.sub` == that agent id and `cnf.jkt` == a thumbprint in the agent's registry keys shipped in the bundle; with mTLS agent certs later, cnf x5t#S256 is checked against the client cert.
- Identity modes per agent from the wire: off (ignore), attribute (verify if present, record failures, allow on policy), require (missing/invalid token -> 407 on CONNECT with Proxy-Authenticate: Basic realm="warden", or 401 JSON after TLS termination; MCP path returns JSON-RPC error).
- Decision events and JSON lines carry sub, act, sid, groups; tokens never logged.
- Metrics: `warden_identity_failures_total{agent,reason}` with bounded reasons (missing, expired, bad_signature, wrong_aud, unknown_kid, cnf_mismatch, agent_mismatch, blocked) and `warden_identity_verified_total{agent}`.
- CP client (config.RemoteProvider and analytics.HTTPRemoteStore) presents the worker cert from p2-worker-ca and reloads it on renew.

## Done when

A worker in require mode rejects requests without a valid, agent-bound Warden token, accepts the harness-issued token, and talks to the CP only over mTLS.

### 1/5 · W-P2-WBND-01

**Verify CP-issued Warden tokens against bundle JWKS**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#111](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/111)

Extend the P1 identity verifier with a WardenTokenVerifier that takes its key set from the last applied signed bundle (hot-swapped on bundle apply in the worker applier), enforces alg allowlist, iss, aud=warden-worker, exp/nbf leeway 30s and known kid, and returns a Principal{Sub, Agent, Groups, SID, Scope, JKT}. Dex tokens remain accepted only when the agent's identity mode is attribute and config `identity.acceptDexTokens: true` (migration aid, default false).

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Token signed by a kid not in bundle JWKS rejected with unknown_kid
- [ ] alg none rejected
- [ ] New JWKS from a bundle takes effect without restart

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-SBND-04`](signed-bundles.md#45--w-p2-sbnd-04) Verify bundles in RemoteProvider and keep last-known-good; [`W-P2-TOKX-02`](token-exchange.md#25--w-p2-tokx-02) Implement token exchange policy checks and JWT minting

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-WBND-02`](identity-enforcement.md#25--w-p2-wbnd-02) Enforce cnf and agent binding for presented tokens

### 2/5 · W-P2-WBND-02

**Enforce cnf and agent binding for presented tokens**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#112](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/112)

In internal/proxy where the P1 code extracts the session token (Proxy-Authorization / X-Warden-Identity), resolve the agent id via agentid.Identifier for the listener port and require Principal.Agent == agent id and Principal.JKT in that agent's registry key thumbprints from the bundle. On mismatch record reason cnf_mismatch or agent_mismatch.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Token minted for agent A presented on agent B's port is rejected
- [ ] Token whose cnf.jkt is not in the registry is rejected
- [ ] Matching token yields decision events with sub, act and sid

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-WBND-01`](identity-enforcement.md#15--w-p2-wbnd-01) Verify CP-issued Warden tokens against bundle JWKS; [`W-P2-AREG-04`](agent-registry.md#44--w-p2-areg-04) Ship per-agent identity mode in the policy wire

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-WBND-03`](identity-enforcement.md#35--w-p2-wbnd-03) Implement identity require mode on HTTP, CONNECT and MCP paths

### 3/5 · W-P2-WBND-03

**Implement identity require mode on HTTP, CONNECT and MCP paths**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#113](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/113)

Add `require` to the per-agent identity mode parsed from the wire (config.AgentIdentity). In require mode a missing or invalid token yields 407 + Proxy-Authenticate on CONNECT, 401 JSON `{error:"identity_required",reason}` after TLS termination, and a JSON-RPC error for MCP via the internal/mcp gateway path; default-deny evaluation still runs after identity passes. Fail closed when no bundle JWKS has been applied yet.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Require mode with no token returns 407 on CONNECT
- [ ] Require mode before first bundle denies all traffic
- [ ] Attribute mode with invalid token still allows per policy and records failure

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-WBND-02`](identity-enforcement.md#25--w-p2-wbnd-02) Enforce cnf and agent binding for presented tokens

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-RCP-03`](identity-client.md#35--w-p2-rcp-03) Add Claude Code compose recipe and docs; [`W-P2-RCP-04`](identity-client.md#45--w-p2-rcp-04) Add Codex CLI compose recipe and docs; [`W-P2-SECT-01`](security-tests.md#14--w-p2-sect-01) Add security test harness with in-process CP, worker and Dex fake; [`W-P2-WBND-04`](identity-enforcement.md#45--w-p2-wbnd-04) Add identity metrics to internal/observability

### 4/5 · W-P2-WBND-04

**Add identity metrics to internal/observability**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#114](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/114)

Add `warden_identity_failures_total{agent,reason}` and `warden_identity_verified_total{agent}` Int64Counters to observability.Metrics with recording methods called from the verifier path; reasons are a fixed enum. Add the counters to the worker dashboard summary.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Each failure reason increments exactly one series
- [ ] Metric labels never include sub or token values

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-WBND-03`](identity-enforcement.md#35--w-p2-wbnd-03) Implement identity require mode on HTTP, CONNECT and MCP paths

### 5/5 · W-P2-WBND-05

**Use worker mTLS client cert for all CP calls**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#115](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/115)

Give config.RemoteProvider and analytics.HTTPRemoteStore a shared *http.Client built by the worker assembler with `tls.Config.GetClientCertificate` reading the current cert from the p2-worker-ca renewer, so renewals apply without restart. Remove the bearer header when a cert is configured (config `controlPlane.clientCert`/`clientKey` or enrollment state dir).

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Long-poll, heartbeat and ingest succeed with only the client cert
- [ ] Cert renewal mid-run does not drop the long-poll
- [ ] No Authorization header sent when mTLS is configured

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-WCA-03`](worker-mtls.md#36--w-p2-wca-03) Add worker enrollment and auto-renew client

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-WCA-06`](worker-mtls.md#66--w-p2-wca-06) Retire per-worker tokens and document migration
